<xf:macro name="og_image" arg-node="{{ null }}"> <xf:if is="$node.CurrentNodeStyling.styling_options.background_image_url.enable"> <xf:set var="$coverImageLink" value="{$node.CurrentNodeStyling.styling_options.background_image_url.value}" />
<xf:if is="$coverImageLink"> <xf:set var="$metaImageValue"> <xf:macro template="metadata_macros" name="image_url" arg-imageUrl="{$coverImageLink}" arg-output="{{ true }}" /> </xf:set> <xf:page option="head.meta_image_url" value="{{$metaImageValue|raw}}" /> </xf:if> </xf:if> </xf:macro>

<xf:macro name="generator"
		  arg-nodeId="!"
		  arg-backgroundSelector="!"
		  arg-textSelector="!"
		  arg-styling="">
	<xf:if contentcheck="true">
	.node--id{$nodeId}, .node-header-{$nodeId}, .block--category{$nodeId} {
		<xf:contentcheck>
			<xf:if is="$styling.text_color && $styling.text_color.enable">
		--node-textColor: {$styling.text_color.value|raw};
			</xf:if>
			<xf:if is="$styling.background_color && $styling.background_color.enable">
		--node-backgroundColor: {$styling.background_color.value|raw};
			</xf:if>
			<xf:foreach loop="{{ thnodes_customcolors() }}" key="$key" value="$value">
				<xf:if is="{$styling.{$value}} && {$styling.{$value}.enable}">
		--node-customColor{$key}: {$styling.{$value}.value|raw};
				</xf:if>
			</xf:foreach>
		</xf:contentcheck>
	}
	</xf:if>

	<xf:if contentcheck="true">
	{$backgroundSelector|raw} {
		<xf:contentcheck>
			<xf:if is="$styling.background_image && $styling.background_image.enable">
		background-image: {$styling.background_image.value|raw} !important;
			</xf:if>
			<xf:if is="$styling.background_image_url && $styling.background_image_url.enable">
		background-image: url({$styling.background_image_url.value|raw}) !important;
		background-size: cover;
			</xf:if>
			<xf:if is="$styling.background_color && $styling.background_color.enable">
		background-color: {$styling.background_color.value|raw} !important;
		background-color: var(--node-backgroundColor, {$styling.background_color.value|raw}) !important;
			</xf:if>
		</xf:contentcheck>
	}
	</xf:if>

	<xf:if contentcheck="true">
	{$textSelector|raw} {
		<xf:contentcheck>
			<xf:if is="$styling.text_color && $styling.text_color.enable">
		color: {$styling.text_color.value|raw} !important;
		color: var(--node-textColor, {$styling.text_color.value|raw}) !important;
			</xf:if>
		</xf:contentcheck>
	}
	</xf:if>

	<xf:if contentcheck="true">
	.node-header-{$nodeId}:not(.thTopic--header) {
		<xf:contentcheck>
			<xf:if is="$styling.background_image && $styling.background_image.enable">
		background-image: {$styling.background_image.value|raw};
			</xf:if>
			<xf:if is="$styling.background_image_url && $styling.background_image_url.enable">
		background-image: url({$styling.background_image_url.value|raw});
		background-size: cover;
		padding: @xf-paddingLarge;
		padding-top: 130px !important;
		position: relative;

		&:before {
			content: '';
			position: absolute;
			top: 0;
			bottom: 0;
			left: 0;
			right: 0;
			display: block;
			background-color: rgba(0,0,0,.4);

			.memberHeader-main&,
			.p-body-header& {
				background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,.1) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.2) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7));
			}
		}

		> * {position: relative;}

		.p-title-value {color: #fff;}

		.p-description {color: rgba(255,255,255,.7);}

		.button--cta {
			color: #fff;
			border: 2px solid #fff;
			background: none;
			box-shadow: none;

			&:hover, &:active, &:focus {
				background: #fff;
				color: @xf-textColor;
			}
		}
			</xf:if>
			<xf:if is="$styling.background_color && $styling.background_color.enable">
		background-color: {$styling.background_color.value|raw};
		background-color: var(--node-backgroundColor, {$styling.background_color.value|raw});
		padding: @xf-paddingLarge;

		.p-title-value {color: #fff;}

		.p-description {color: rgba(255,255,255,.7);}

		.button--cta {
			color: #fff;
			border: 2px solid #fff;
			background: none;
			box-shadow: none;

			&:hover, &:active, &:focus {
				background: #fff;
				color: @xf-textColor;
			}
		}
			</xf:if>
		</xf:contentcheck>
		padding-bottom: 16px;

		<xf:if contentcheck="true">
		.p-title-value {
			<xf:contentcheck>
				<xf:if is="$styling.text_color && $styling.text_color.enable">
			color: {$styling.text_color.value|raw};
			color: var(--node-textColor, {$styling.text_color.value|raw});
				</xf:if>
			</xf:contentcheck>
		}
		</xf:if>
	}
	</xf:if>
</xf:macro>
